text:
jordan: Thinking out loud — we need a safer rollout for the new "graceful throttle" config that routes overflow to cheaper model variants instead of hard 429s. Want to agree on semantics + console UX + monitoring before we flip it on wide.
sasha: big +1. main risks: stealthy quality regressions and hidden cost shifts. we should require dry-run + sampling UI. :eyes:
neha: propose two modes: 
1) request-level fallback (per-request if route overloaded)
2) session-level fallback (pin session to fallback after first hit).
session-level is simpler to reason about for customers.
mike: for rollout, suggest: 1% accounts (not requests) -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, with telemetry gates at each step (error-rate, p99 latency, token-cost delta).
jordan: agree on accounts-based canary. need an exponentiating backoff on the throttle so we don't oscillate. also need clear audit logs of which requests were routed where.
chris: console changes: add a "preview" toggle that shows estimated token/cost delta from historical traffic if dry-run enabled. also add a per-flag "rollback" button that stores the last N config states.
sasha: telemetry gates: require stable error-rate within +0.5% and p99 latency within +30ms for 1h after increase. if violated, auto-roll back to previous config and page #oncall with runbook link.
neha: sample config snippet we can use in runtime API (draft):
```json
{
  "feature": "graceful_throttle",
  "mode": "request", // or "session"
  "fallback_model": "redwood-3-small-quant",
  "threshold_qps": 3000,
  "grace_seconds": 2,
  "backoff": {
    "initial_ms": 50,
    "factor": 1.5,
    "max_ms": 2000
  },
  "dry_run": true,
  "audit": {
    "enabled": true,
    "sample_rate": 0.01
  }
}
```
mike: a couple API notes: 
- prefer explicit "mode" instead of ad-hoc flags
- sampling and dry_run should be queryable via /configs/:id/status for debugging
jordan: ops/rollout plan: create canary config -> enable dry_run:true for 24h -> enable for 1% accounts (dry_run still on) for 6h with telemetry checks -> flip dry_run off for that cohort -> progress percent after each 24h window if gates pass.
sasha: how do we surface per-account rollouts in the console? current UI only shows percent-of-requests. we need percent-of-accounts and list of affected account IDs.
chris: backend already stores cohorts by account_id hash. frontend change: show cohort preview and allow manual override for specific accounts. add export CSV.
neha: important: experiments + evals. before full rollout we should run the fallback on an offline evaluation of 10k historical requests and compute BLEU-like heuristics + policy safety metrics. attach results to the rollout history.
mike: telemetry plumbing: increment metrics: routing.fallback.count, routing.primary.count, routing.latency.primary.p99, routing.latency.fallback.p99, routing.quality.metric.delta. make sure these are tagged by config_id and cohort.
jordan: alerting thresholds: fallback.count_rate > 5% AND cost_delta > +10% -> page #oncall. also page if quality_delta_breach.
sasha: ops-bot suggestion: run a dry-run sweep next monday at 02:00 UTC for the canary cohort and attach results to the rollout ticket. deploy-bot: scheduled. :robot_face:
deploy-bot: scheduled job created: graceful-throttle/dryrun-canary@2240200000 -> will post summary to thread and upload CSV to the rollout ticket.
mike: one final API debate: do we allow per-route overrides (yes) and per-model compatibility checks (must be explicit). if fallback model lacks function-calling or streaming, we should fail the assignment at validate-time.
neha: validation idea: add `compatibility_requirements` array to the config. runtime validator checks model capabilities and rejects if mismatch.
jordan: action items: 
- neha: write offline eval harness & run 10k requests by Fri (ticket #PLAT-759)
- chris: console cohort UI mockups by Wed, include percent-of-accounts view (ticket #UX-432)
- sasha: add telemetry gate rules + alerting playbook (ticket #SRE-881)
- mike: extend /configs API with status endpoint + audit sampling toggle (ticket #API-210)
- i'll draft rollout doc + runbook and link to ticket.
sasha: thanks — let's keep the rollout conservative. prefer more telemetry over faster expansion. :thumbsup:
